task: daily CTA route rides forecasting; pooled regression with seasonal baselines
target: rides, the source's measured daily route boardings

information_policy.assumption: At issue date D, ride observations through D-1 may be used.
information_policy.schedule_snapshot_policy: Use a whole-network GTFS snapshot captured strictly before the target/issue date for daily replay.
information_policy.daytype: CTA daytype is known at forecast issue time; validate the calendar source before operational use.

model_selection.selected_on: validation MAE only; no test-period model selection

paired_matched_experiment.purpose: Estimate the added value of schedule features on identical route/date partitions and rows.

prior_test_history_note: The June-July dates were evaluated in previous project iterations. This v3-aligned run is development evidence, not an untouched final holdout; freeze later choices before a future-period evaluation.
